close_reason: Satisfied by fz-k22.21; the former cross-call Enum element-ABI failures pass interp, JIT, and AOT at edb0478a9.
description:
Goal

Semantically distinct Enum list-helper activations must retain their own structural element ABI. Their physical representative may be shared only when the settled surfaces are observably equivalent; raw Ty ids, debug text, or publication order cannot decide the representative.

Resolution

fz-k22.21 replaced Ty-id and debug-derived determinism tie-breaks with structural keys and structurally ordered local callable producers. That removed the representative-selection instability which allowed an integer-list helper to lend its RawInt element ABI to a later string-list helper.

Verification at edb0478a9

The previously discriminating pairs all pass the backend interpreter, JIT, and AOT:

- Enum.scan over integers followed by Enum.with_index over strings.
- Enum.map_every over integers followed by Enum.map_join over strings.

Both pairs produce the correct values and no longer abort in fz_list_head_int_ref. The remaining Enum.with_index callback failure is independent and tracked by fz-9i4.7.10.
title: Keep independent Enum list-helper activations on their structural element ABIs
